name: figure_stand
why: Mitten forward at hip with the lantern hanging clear at the right edge, matching the FIGS.stand hand anchor; edge-on hood crescent, unlit lantern, identity matches the approved Keeper.

name: figure_walk
why: Clearest stride of the three with both boots readable and the lantern swinging forward; same cloak, hood and hem stripes as the stand pick.

name: figure_ride
why: Most compact forward lean on parallel skis with the lantern held out ahead like the concept ride plate; reads as motion at thumbnail size.

name: figure_crouch
why: Tucked hold pose with single clean ski pair (v1 doubles the skis), lantern low and forward, hood stays edge-on.

name: figure_sit
why: Calm seated mass with the lantern set down beside the boots; widest crescent-free hood profile and best felt texture.

name: lighthouse
why: Most slender tower, closest to the current proportions and lamp height; dark unlit lantern room, plain white shaft, snowy granite base with laminated edge.

name: sauna_hut
why: Chunky log ends, birch ply door and bench, laminated snow-roof edge and stove pipe; no lit window, no coral, closest to the props-sheet language.

name: birch_cluster
why: Clear tall/medium/short trunk hierarchy keeps the silhouette readable at 32 px; a few golden leaves as in the concept birch, laminated snow mound.

name: pier_boat
why: Deck edge shows the laminated ply layers, round posts and a birch ply rowing boat with ply-edge gunwale at the right end; footprint matches the current asset.

name: boathouse
why: Aspect closest to the current file (about 1.4:1), laminated gable trim under a soft snow roof, dark kaamos-blue doors; no lit openings.
